title: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Education — Simple Present
titleVi: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Giáo dục — Thì Hiện Tại Đơn

speakingCueCard.prompt: Describe your favourite subject at school.
bulletPoints: How the teacher makes it interesting

questionPrompt: Read the speaking response below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
questionPromptVi: Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây. Chọn mỗi lỗi ngữ pháp bạn phát hiện bằng cách bôi đen. Bạn có thể gõ bản sửa đúng vào ô hiện ra.
passageText: My favourite subject is definitely science because I love learning about how the world works. Our teacher always explain things using fun experiments, and that really helps me understand better. I feel excited every time we go to the laboratory, even though some of my classmates find it boring. I think science teach us how to think carefully and ask good questions.

errors.explanation: 'Our teacher' is third-person singular — the verb needs -s: 'explains', not 'explain'.
errors.explanationVi: 'Our teacher' là ngôi thứ ba số ít — động từ cần thêm -s: 'explains', không phải 'explain'.

errors.explanation: 'Science' is a singular subject, so the verb requires -es: 'teaches', not 'teach'.
errors.explanationVi: 'Science' là chủ ngữ số ít, nên động từ cần thêm -es: 'teaches', không phải 'teach'.

falseAlarmZones.text: some of my classmates find it boring
falseAlarmZones.hint: 'Find' is correct — 'classmates' is plural, so the base form 'find' is used, not 'finds'.

collocations.translation: thế giới vận hành như thế nào
collocations.exampleSentence: Children are naturally curious about how the world works.
collocations.grammarNote: 'How + S + V' — không dùng 'how does the world works' trong mệnh đề danh từ

collocations.exampleSentence: The teacher uses fun experiments to help students understand chemistry.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Fun' dùng như tính từ trước danh từ — tự nhiên trong văn nói

collocations.exampleSentence: Watching videos online helps me understand better when the textbook is confusing.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Help + somebody + V(bare)' — không dùng 'helps me to understand' trong văn nói tự nhiên

collocations.exampleSentence: A good student knows how to ask good questions during class.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Ask questions' — không dùng 'make questions' hay 'do questions'

generationMatrix.discourseSituation: A student emotionally describing why they love science class
